name: Ore no Musume
source:
His wife died, leaving him to care for his daughter. It was a good life in spite of things. 
But suddenly his daughter too was taken by fate. He fell into deep despair. 
Perhaps out of pity, a goddess took the form of a young girl and came to him. 
Together, holding her loving hand, he took his first steps back to happiness. 

But what price would this miracle bring--- 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096762.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
妻子去世后，他独自照顾女儿。尽管生活有各种困难，日子仍算不错。

但突然，女儿也被命运夺走，他陷入深深绝望。

也许出于怜悯，一位女神化作年轻女孩来到他身边。两人牵着她充满爱意的手，一起踏上回归幸福的第一步。

但这场奇迹要付出怎样的代价——

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096762.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
